_comment: Copy to ~/.config/spark-monitor/config.json and edit. Every key is optional; see docs/CONFIGURATION.md. JSON has no comments, so delete the _comment keys.
_comment_nodes: host: null means the machine running the dashboard. All other nodes need passwordless SSH from it - see docs/MULTI-NODE.md.
_comment_ports: Ports where an inference engine might be listening. vLLM defaults to 8000, llama.cpp to 8080. List only what you use.
_comment_power: Starting values only; the UI's Settings form overrides them. Calibrate with a smart plug - see docs/METRICS.md.
